heading: Biggest updates yet!
notes: Gapless: Enjoy music without any delay. Songs transition immediately, with no gap in between. (May have issues with MP3s. It is being worked on.)
Frutiger Aero Theme Pack: Enjoy a free pack built in when you download Gumi RPC. Completely optional if you don't want to use it.
Lyrics: Songs display lyrics right there for you to read and sing along to. (Some songs may not have lyrics, but if we find them there will be an update on that.)

Equalizer + 8D Audio: A new way to enjoy music on the Gumi app. Next to the lyrics button you'll see a waveform button, which opens the Equalizer and 8D Audio. 1. The Equalizer: customize how you enjoy music, or pick one of the presets. 2. The 8D Audio: your music transforms, like it's being played in an empty hall.

New Album Selection: When an album is selected, you'll be taken to a menu where you can look at all the albums, songs, and playlists. Queue them up and enjoy a full selection of music, or shuffle a playlist.

CD Customization: Don't like the CD gimmick? Fair. You can toggle it off in Settings, turning the CD into the base album cover for both Discord and the app. Or if you don't like the CD hole on the app, you can turn that off in Settings too.
subheading: Gapless, Frutiger Aero, Lyrics, Equalizer + 8D Audio, Album Selection improvements, and CD Customizations.

heading: Discord card no longer covers the songs
notes: The Discord account card is a landscape row now, sitting above the player instead of a tall column that covered the song list.
Sign out stays visible — it no longer hides behind the player.
subheading: The Discord card sits above the player instead of covering your songs.

heading: Custom equalizer button + a huge 8D hall
notes: The equalizer preset row has a Custom button now. Moving a slider by hand switches to Custom and saves your build — and it starts from the preset you were on, so a tweak keeps the rest of that preset instead of resetting the other bands to flat. Tapping Custom later brings your saved build back, even after switching to another preset.
The 8D reverb is a huge hall now — a longer 2.5 second impulse with more of it in the mix, so the sound feels wider and more spacious.
subheading: Your custom EQ build is a real preset now, and 8D sounds like a huge hall.

heading: 8D audio, tuned to the SICKO MODE example
notes: The 8D sweep is slower now — one full left-right pass takes about 11 seconds instead of 8, matching the example Brandon sent.
The reverb room stays centred while the dry sound moves around inside it, so it feels like the music is circling you in a room instead of the whole room swinging with it.
The room itself is tighter now (a ~1.2 second impulse instead of 1.8), so the reverb sits closer and the sound stays clear.
subheading: The 8D sweep is slower, the room stays put, and the sound circles you in it.

heading: Persona 3 wallpaper handoff + Game Section
notes: The wallpaper intro now plays once and holds its last frame, and both GIFs are preloaded before the swap — the intro-to-loop handoff is seamless, with no visible skip.
The Game Section is no longer a solid block — the wallpaper shows through it and the game rows float on it as Persona boxes.
subheading: A seamless intro-to-loop handoff and a Game Section that lets the wallpaper through.

heading: CD hole toggle
notes: A new CD hole toggle in Settings > CD — turn it off and the spinning CD loses its centre hole, so the album cover stays whole.
The toggle only appears while CD in the app is on, since the hole only exists on the spinning CD.
subheading: Hide the hole in the middle of the spinning CD.

heading: A brand new version
notes: CD toggles in Settings — separate switches for the CD on Discord and the CD in the app.
Developer / Showcasing mode (dev copy only) — swap your real library for a sample one when showing the app.
Equalizer with five modes, a custom slider view, and 8D audio that sweeps around the room.
Album glide — tap an album and its cover glides to a full-screen detail view; switch albums from the strip without backing out, and queue songs right from the list.
My Themes is now a proper selection menu — search by name, grouped, with a label on every card.
Patch notes — read any version's notes from the little notepad at the top right.
Gumi-Auto — a tiny app that ships a release from one window.
subheading: CD toggles, Showcasing mode, an equalizer with 8D audio, the album glide, a theme menu, patch notes, and Gumi-Auto.

heading: Gumi-Auto
notes: Gumi-Auto — a tiny app that ships a release from one window: patch notes, token, build zip, upload to GitHub.
The patch notes panel now shows each release's heading and subheading when they are there.
subheading: A tiny app that ships a release from one window

notes: Patch notes — read them anytime from the little notepad at the top right.
Write each version's notes in this file (patch-notes.json) and they show up here.
My Themes is now a proper selection menu — search by name, grouped into Built-in and My themes, with a label on every card (Built-in, Pack, or Picture).
Album glide — tap an album or playlist card and its cover glides to a full-screen detail view with only that album's songs. The back arrow glides it home.
Equalizer with five modes — Flat, Bass boost, Vocal / Podcasts, Treble, Clarity — right of the lyrics button in Now Playing.
8D audio (experimental, free) — the sound slowly sweeps around your head.
Developer / Showcasing mode (dev copy only) — swaps your real library for a sample one so a screenshot or video never shows anyone else's albums.
CD toggles in Settings — separate switches for the CD on Discord and the CD in the app.
Fixed the Aero theme music going missing after the LEASE rename.
